description: Next.js profile API validating user-supplied input with catastrophic-backtracking regexes: the widely copied URL regex with a nested ([\/\w .-]*)* path group (VC080 must fire), and the OWASP textbook display-name pattern ([a-zA-Z]+\s?)*. The second is a known gap: VC080 only recognises a group whose LAST token is quantified with + or *, so a repeated group ending in an optional \s? is not seen. VC080 is being rewritten in PR #828; drop knownGap once it detects this
